signals_and_integrations.ecosystem_role: No external OpenTelemetry logs feature is required.

signals_and_integrations.production_path: OtelMetrics records into a caller-supplied Meter; the embedder SDK owns collection and export.
signals_and_integrations.ecosystem_role: Only production collector-bound path for metrics.

signals_and_integrations.production_path: Owned bounded in-process trace pipeline; collector-bound spans use the embedder BoxedTracer SDK path.
signals_and_integrations.ecosystem_role: Only production collector-bound path for traces.

signals_and_integrations.production_path: OtelMetrics::new, new_with_resource_detection, and new_with_config accept a caller-supplied opentelemetry::metrics::Meter.

wire_contract.endpoint_policy: Caller-supplied signal URL is used verbatim; no /v1 path is appended.
wire_contract.status_semantics: 2xx success; 408, 429, and 502-504 retryable; 405 and other non-retryable 4xx/5xx drop; 415 permits one uncompressed retry.

configuration_contracts.name: endpoint
configuration_contracts.contract: Caller-supplied full signal URL is used verbatim.

configuration_contracts.name: timeout
configuration_contracts.contract: Per-attempt timeout defaults to 10 seconds; expiry is non-retryable and bounded.

configuration_contracts.name: retry
configuration_contracts.contract: Defaults are 3 retries, 100ms initial delay, 30s maximum delay, deterministic exponential backoff, and Retry-After precedence.

configuration_contracts.name: compression
configuration_contracts.contract: Gzip defaults off; requesting it without the compression feature is a hard error.

configuration_contracts.name: auth
configuration_contracts.contract: Bearer, API-key, and custom headers are supported and treated as secrets.

configuration_contracts.name: tls
configuration_contracts.contract: TLS is fail-closed with no HTTPS-to-HTTP or silent CA fallback.

configuration_contracts.name: resource_attributes
configuration_contracts.contract: Precedence is built-in defaults, OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES, then programmatic values; hostname detection is opt-in.

configuration_contracts.name: scope_attributes
configuration_contracts.contract: Pinned scope and schema defaults are overridable per log snapshot.

configuration_contracts.name: cardinality
configuration_contracts.contract: Metric names and label combinations are bounded with Drop, Aggregate, or Warn overflow and observable counts.

configuration_contracts.name: privacy_redaction
configuration_contracts.contract: Drop lists, glob allowlist, custom regex, and built-in PII detectors cover all signals; redaction may widen only.

configuration_contracts.name: attribute_caps
configuration_contracts.contract: Logs allow 128 attributes and 4096 value bytes with counted drops.

configuration_contracts.name: sampling
configuration_contracts.contract: Metric sampling and head-based trace sampling are deterministic.

configuration_contracts.name: load_shedding
configuration_contracts.contract: Bounded queues count drops; metrics drop newest, traces drop oldest, and trace brownout is explicit.

user_journeys.description: Encode log records with owned prost messages and send them through explicit-Cx OTLP/HTTP.
user_journeys.required_completion: Owned encoder differential proof and live collector acceptance.

user_journeys.description: Use the default-feature bounded in-process trace exporter with deterministic sampling and brownout.
user_journeys.required_completion: Preserve default reachability and explicit tail-sampling support class.

user_journeys.description: Supply a Meter from an external SdkMeterProvider to OtelMetrics and preserve long-path PrivacyConfig access.
user_journeys.required_completion: The standalone downstream crate must instantiate OtelMetrics from its own provider.

user_journeys.description: Record through OtelMetrics while an embedder SDK owns collection; retain the dependency-free Prometheus text registry as a separate local path.
user_journeys.required_completion: Compile a real pinned Prometheus exporter consumer instead of relying on the documented 0.17 snippet.

user_journeys.description: Handle partial success, throttle, Retry-After, auth failure, TLS failure, unsupported media type, and terminal HTTP responses.
user_journeys.required_completion: Activate valid fixtures and run named real collector versions without mocks.

user_journeys.description: Cancel, flush, drain, and shut down bounded queues without task, obligation, batch, or retry-loop leaks.
user_journeys.required_completion: Prove task and obligation leak freedom plus region quiescence for every signal and HTTP retry path.

known_gaps.summary: No owned production wire encoder exists for metrics or traces.
Synchronous HTTP exporter trait methods reject use because real sends need explicit Cx.
new_with_resource_detection constructs and discards resource attributes.
OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_* and scheduled collection are unsupported.
Owned logs encode only string OTLP AnyValue bodies.
The quarantined OTLP audit cluster contains tracked files that are not compiled and cannot count as evidence.
